title: The Scarf with Two Ends
youtube_title: The Scarf with Two Ends | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Making room at the table is a kind of abundance.
summary: At a ferry bench with a folded blanket, Bodhi sees that a long scarf with two ends and one neck that was colder will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Bodhi makes a smaller, even share so Nim is included, and Miss Dalca lets the choice stand without a speech.
